name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Grzegorz Braun
part_text:
The European Parliament is lifting the legal protection that Grzegorz Braun, a Polish member, has as an elected representative. Polish prosecutors asked for this so they can pursue criminal cases against him. The cases involve an incident at a hospital in Oleśnica in April 2025, damage to posters in Opole in March 2025, and an online interview in December 2023. Parliament found no sign that the cases were brought to harm his political work.

- Polish prosecutors can now pursue criminal cases against Grzegorz Braun.
- It affects Grzegorz Braun and the Polish authorities handling his cases.
- Parliament's President sends the decision to Poland's prosecutor and to Braun.
